```{python}
#|output: false
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

df = pd.DataFrame(
  {('Self-contained', '34-'): {'Independent accommodation': '273', 'Internal move: backwards': '81',
                               'Insecure outcome (external)': '57', 'Returned to homelessness': '46', 'Other': '36',
                               'Internal move: forwards': '25', 'Internal move: sideways': '24', 'Died': '3'},
   ('Self-contained', '35+'): {'Independent accommodation': '502', 'Internal move: backwards': '184',
                               'Insecure outcome (external)': '65', 'Returned to homelessness': '59', 'Other': '34',
                               'Internal move: forwards': '57', 'Internal move: sideways': '14', 'Died': '30'},
   ('Shared', '34-'): {'Independent accommodation': '25', 'Internal move: backwards': '10',
                       'Insecure outcome (external)': '9', 'Returned to homelessness': '13', 'Other': '23',
                       'Internal move: forwards': '1', 'Internal move: sideways': '4', 'Died': '0'},
   ('Shared', '35+'): {'Independent accommodation': '58', 'Internal move: backwards': '32',
                       'Insecure outcome (external)': '17', 'Returned to homelessness': '5', 'Other': '5',
                       'Internal move: forwards': '5', 'Internal move: sideways': '3', 'Died': '1'}}
      ).astype("Int64")
df.columns = df.columns.rename(("Accommodation Type", "Age Group"))
df.index.rename("Outcome", inplace=True)
df = df.unstack().rename("Count").reset_index()
```

## Contingency table for under 35s

```{python}
df_u35 = df[df["Age Group"] == "34-"]
ct_u35 = pd.crosstab(df_u35["Outcome"], df_u35["Accommodation Type"], aggfunc="sum", values=df_u35["Count"])
display(ct_u35)
chi_2_u35 = stats.chi2_contingency(ct_u35.astype("int"))
print(f"Chi2 statistic: {chi_2_u35.statistic:.3f}, p-value: {chi_2_u35.pvalue:.3f}")
```

## Contingency table for over 35s

```{python}
df_35o = df[df["Age Group"] == "35+"]
ct_35o = pd.crosstab(df_35o["Outcome"], df_35o["Accommodation Type"], aggfunc="sum", values=df_35o["Count"])
display(ct_35o)
chi_2_35o = stats.chi2_contingency(ct_35o.astype("int"))
print(f"Chi2 statistic: {chi_2_35o.statistic:.3f}, p-value: {chi_2_35o.pvalue:.3f}")
```

## Contingency table for shared

```{python}
df_shared = df[df["Accommodation Type"] == "Shared"]
ct_shared = pd.crosstab(df_shared["Outcome"], df_shared["Age Group"], aggfunc="sum", values=df_shared["Count"])
display(ct_shared)
chi_2_shared = stats.chi2_contingency(ct_shared.astype("int"))
print(f"Chi2 statistic: {chi_2_shared.statistic:.3f}, p-value: {chi_2_shared.pvalue:.3f}")
```

## Contingency table for self-contained

```{python}
df_sc = df[df["Accommodation Type"] == "Self-contained"]
ct_sc = pd.crosstab(df_sc["Outcome"], df_sc["Age Group"], aggfunc="sum", values=df_sc["Count"])
display(ct_sc)
```

## Percentages
```{python}
df_ct = (df.pivot_table(index="Outcome", columns=["Age Group", "Accommodation Type"], margins=True)
         .astype("int")
         .droplevel(0, axis=1)
         .iloc[:-1, :]
         .sort_values("All", ascending=False)
         .iloc[:, :-1]
         .rename(columns={"34-": "Under 35"}))
df_prop = df_ct.apply(lambda x: x/x.sum())
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.1%}".format):
    display(df_prop)
```

```{python}
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn.objects as so
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (7.5, 5),
    'font.size': 11,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
```

```{python}
plot_data_n = df_ct.unstack().reset_index(name="value")
plot_data_pr = df_prop.unstack().reset_index(name="value")
fig = plt.figure()
p = (so.Plot(data=plot_data_pr, x="value", y="Outcome")
     .layout(size=(7.5, 5))
     .add(so.Bars(), so.Dodge())
     .facet(col="Age Group", row="Accommodation Type")
     .scale(x=so.Continuous().label(like=".0%"))
     .label(x=None, y=None)
     .on(fig)
     .plot(pyplot=True))
annot_text = "Very different for\nunder-35s in shared"
fig.axes[2].annotate(annot_text, xy=(0.298,0), xytext=(.7, .2), xycoords="data", textcoords="axes fraction",
                     horizontalalignment="center", va="top", color=(0,0,0,0),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=(0,0,0,0.7)))
fig.axes[2].annotate(annot_text, xy=(0.154,3), xytext=(.7, .2), xycoords="data", textcoords="axes fraction",
                     horizontalalignment="center", va="top", color=(0,0,0,0),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=(0,0,0,0.7)))
fig.axes[2].annotate(annot_text, xy=(0.271,4), xytext=(.7, .2), xycoords="data", textcoords="axes fraction",
                     horizontalalignment="center", va="top",
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=(0,0,0,0.7)),
                     bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="0.8", alpha=0.7))
plt.show(block=False)
fig.savefig(f"{output_dir}/Figure_16.svg")
```
